title: Widget demo review
intro: A tiny sample checklist to show the overlay. Mark each step pass/fail/n-a, add a note, then download the report.

steps.do: Open the Review panel (bottom-right) and enter your name.
steps.expect: The panel expands and remembers your name on reload.
The mark sticks and the progress count updates.

steps.do: Add a freeform note for this page.
steps.expect: It appears in the notes list and in the downloaded report.
You get an .md and a .json file carrying your marks and notes.
